name: Mip-NeRF 360 MLP Architecture
definition: A Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) architecture for NeRF that uses integrated positional encoding for 3D points and optional directional encoding for view/reflection directions, supporting features like specular tinting, roughness prediction, and GLO vectors.
summary: The Mip-NeRF 360 MLP architecture uses integrated positional encoding to handle aliasing and supports advanced appearance modeling like specular tinting and roughness prediction.
